responsibility: Defines the public communication interface between IRA and the rest of GCC. It declares target-specific IRA data tables for allocatable classes, pressure classes, hard-register availability, move costs, and mode constraints; exposes global allocator state such as equivalence information and LRA selection; and publishes helper APIs used by reload, LRA, and other RTL passes for class setup, equivalence handling, stack-slot reuse, spill heuristics, scratch handling, and asm-goto nullification. It is the external counterpart to ira-int.h’s private implementation header.
same_name_distinction: This is the public IRA interface header, defining shared target_ira tables, allocator state, and helper declarations used by reload, LRA, and other passes. The same-stem source gcc/ira.cc is the executable control-plane implementation that drives IRA and its reload/LRA integration.
